name: Redmine MCP Server
description: Exposes Redmine data to MCP clients through OAuth 2.1 authentication, enabling AI agents to manage projects, issues, and time entries. It supports a variety of operations including issue creation, full-text search, and time logging via a secure HTTP transport.
